integrity: The proof is a direct synthesis of quantifier elimination, primeness/local finiteness of the Fraïssé limit, the algebraic-closure characterization, and the published continuum family of three-generated types. A finite verifier checks only the low-arity Steiner closure facts.
scientific_limitations: Only empty-set types in the pure Steiner-quasigroup language are covered. No classification over parameters, no topology of the nonisolated locus, and no count of isolated n-types for n>=3 is claimed.
title: Isolation in the generic Steiner quasigroup is exactly finite generated closure
